Increase orders with promotions | Wolt for Merchants - Wolt (Estonia) 

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/2cBgqDVcVU5H1soUPWs3nH/fffc84ddee4dc67219900037711a4631/Courier_partner_Austria_092.jpg?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

# Increase orders with promotions

Attract new and repeat customers with promotions that entice them to order and spend more per order.

Get started

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/2cBgqDVcVU5H1soUPWs3nH/fffc84ddee4dc67219900037711a4631/Courier_partner_Austria_092.jpg?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

## Stand out from the crowd

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/28OGIRLaTga3g6IZWYj0fj/3d1e6f5c0bb3b2d393e9600cc3d77e1e/FireWorks_v003.png?w=3840&q=95&fm=webp)

### Drive more sales

Merchants using promotions see an uplift of 30-45% during campaign weeks.\*

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/1InaYKH4ssZGuvsqJamwvX/4b423c84605ca898f79aec2c5e6cb49c/DiscountTags_v003.png?w=3840&q=95&fm=webp)

### Customize your offers

Choose the best promotion type that best suits your business and customers.

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/7ofS1ZFqRMWfXq6Mg8Cp60/fecd72f1464b55ca7c1f07fb1511c95e/PhoneMessages_v003.png?w=3840&q=95&fm=webp)

### Get discovered

Your business will feature in the most highly visible places across the Wolt app, potentially increasing impressions by up to 150%.\*

## How it works?

Incentivize new or existing customers to order from your store with a discount, free delivery, or a free item. When you run a promotion, your business will be prominently featured to your target audience in the Offers tab on the Wolt app. Get step-by-step instructions and learn best practices for how to create, customize, and optimize Wolt marketing campaigns.

[Build your campaign](https://merchant.wolt.com/)

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/2VJF1LnkPqFEJK2J3gqtRJ/e48a76835ee5f99cdd2d1f9c0117cade/promotions.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

## Explore wolt promotions

*   ![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/3KXyPWWEOIPo0KJAIdAdLR/aca19a32deaef3b18cc44dd376a47a6b/Wolt_Shopping_Basket_Groceries.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)
    
    ### Discounts for Customers
    
    Attract new customers or re-engage existing ones with a percentage or € amount discount.
    
*   ![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/36SVc5zGPSoB1f5GFryhqI/63c4fc4e2484250f170c34797af44166/Wolt-Market-interior.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)
    
    ### €0 Delivery Fee
    
    Entice customers by covering the delivery fee when they place an order from your business.
    
*   ![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/78qrog1yRH4Lto2OGNDy7I/add038c4903e79042a0f4b134d7a6126/Sticker_02_copy.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)
    
    ### Free or Discounted Item
    
    Increase profits with a free or discounted item from your selection.
    

## Set up your first promotion

Getting started is easy. Choose the desired campaign type, and we will guide you through the process.

[Build your campaign](https://merchant.wolt.com/)

## Reach more customers with in-app advertising

Get more people to discover your promotion by running an ad on Wolt. You only pay for ads when an order is placed through it – you aren’t charged for clicks or impressions. 96% of the venues that used Wolt Ads increased their venue visits up to 4x during their campaign period.

[Explore Wolt Ads](https://merchant.wolt.com/en/est/wolt-ads/restaurants-and-stores)

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/5scksPwHcCGdzALskFSGST/c1d0fffa20163a089935f60ae92b3978/Screenshot_2023-06-09_at_11.16.18_AM.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

## Getting started is easy – sign up today

Sign up and get the most out of Wolt. Just fill in a few details about your business and you'll be all set in no time.

Get started

## FAQs

### How do I get started with Wolt promotions?

Once you’re a Wolt partner, log into the [Merchant Portal](https://merchant.wolt.com/) and navigate to the Campaigns tab and click "New campaign". Choose the type of campaign you want to run based on your goals. Customize your promotion details, set a duration and launch your campaign. After your campaign is live, view its performance in the Campaigns tab in the Merchant Portal. You can make adjustments or end your campaign at any time.

### Where do customers see my promotions?

Your target audience will see your promotion when they visit your store, on the "Offers near you" carousel found on the Discovery page, and in searches. When a promotion is running, a corresponding badge is added to those locations.

### What kind of promotions are available on Wolt?

You can target new or all customers by selecting from the following promotions: - Discount for Customers: Attract new customers or win back inactive customers with a percentage or € amount discount. Set a minimum subtotal to increase ticket sizes. - €0 Delivery Fee for New Customers: Entice customers by covering the delivery fee when they place an order from your business. - Offer Free or Discounted Items: Offer customers a free or discounted item from your menu like "buy one get 1 free" to encourage customers to buy certain products.

### Do I need marketing experience to run a promotion?

No, you don't. Promotions are designed for busy merchants with varying levels of marketing experience. Visit the Campaigns tab in the Merchant Portal and we’ll guide you through the creation of your promotion. Once your promotion is live, you’ll easily be able to make adjustments and monitor its performance in the Merchant Portal. To create a campaign, users will need to have Access Role of "Merchant Owner" or "Venue Owner".

### How am I charged for Promotions?

You only pay for confirmed orders placed through your promotion. That means your campaign investment result in actual sales — not just clicks or impressions. The cost of the promotion will be deducted from the following payment made by Wolt.

### Where can I go if I have more questions about promotions?

For any question on using promotions for your venue, reach out to your account manager.

\* Internal Wolt data, January 2022 to July 2023. Results are averages across partners. Actual results may vary based on campaign setup.

# Wolt's Delivery Talent: Grow's Rapid Ramp-Up

Wolt is a technology company that provides on-demand delivery services, connecting merchants, couriers, and customers.  
To solve Wolt’s recruiting challenges due to their limited in-house TA resources, Grow rapidly ramped up to manage high hiring volume effectively and leveraged our expertise in in-house recruiting and food delivery space to recruit for a wide range of roles, particularly in Hokkaido and Tohoku regions where the recruiting landscape is significantly different from larger cities like Tokyo and Osaka.

Challenges

Challenges

**Limited Candidate Pool**  
Revised sourcing strategies and collaborated with hiring managers to improve candidate engagement and feedback.

**High Dependency on Inbound and Agency**  
Fostered outbound sourcing mindset by boosting direct sourcing volume and reducing hiring costs on paid channels.

**Inefficient Recruitment Process**  
Strategically restructured interview processes and accelerated the hiring pipeline.

Results

Results

**Successful Offer Generation**  
Generated 22+ offers within 5 months with 77% acceptance rate.

**Rapid Scaling of the TA Team**  
Helped their TA team grow by 150% within 4 months.

**Improved Recruitment Efficiency**  
Transitioned from a reliance on inbound sources to a more balanced approach, leveraging outbound channels and reducing dependency on paid platforms.

results.title: How to Set Up Your First Wolt Ads Campaign in Greece - Wolt (Greece)
results.markdown:
How to Set Up Your First Wolt Ads Campaign in Greece - Wolt (Greece) 

# How to set up and run your first Wolt Ads campaign

![A bearded man sits in a booth holding a red mug, with a laptop, an apple, and a sandwich on the table.](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/6nLouKQDQHbSlGGlVDRV2M/2c5021dc11533de10df0273975f10a3f/How_to_set_up_and_run_your_first_Wolt_Ads_campaign.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

Wolt Ads use Sponsored Listings to help your restaurant appear in prominent places across the Wolt app, including Discovery and search. That extra visibility can help customers find you when they are deciding what to order, and you only pay when an ad leads to a completed order.

If this is your first in-app campaign, you do not need to have every answer on day one. The setup is designed to be simple, and your first campaign can be a focused test. In [Wolt's 2025 global local commerce report](https://press.wolt.com/en-WW/251504-5-billion-in-wolt-generated-sales-new-report-shows-how-platforms-empower-local-businesses/), 81% of consumers who had ordered restaurant food said they discovered new venues on Wolt. The study covered 23 markets across Europe and Asia, so treat the figure as global context rather than a Greece-specific result.

Let's walk through how to prepare, launch and learn from your first campaign.

## **What exactly are Wolt Ads and how do they work?**

Sponsored Listings can place your venue in top positions across the Wolt app, including the Discovery tab, search results, Restaurant and Store pages, and cart recommendations. The [Wolt Ads page](https://merchant.wolt.com/wolt-ads/restaurants-and-stores) explains where these promoted placements can appear.

Sponsored Listings use a pay-per-order model. You set your campaign budget and pay only when a customer places a completed order through your ad. You are not charged for clicks or views that do not lead to a sale, so your budget stays focused on measurable results.

Wolt Ads increase your visibility without changing your menu, prices or ratings. Your venue page then helps customers decide what to order, so clear photos, accurate information and a well-organized menu all play an important role.

## **What should you prepare before launching?**

![A man laughs while preparing pizza inside a food truck decorated with bunting and paper Wolt bags on the shelf.](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/2V8tb1oCbEt05EFtp37uvL/97218a07d680b984a5909707e40bebd0/What_should_you_prepare_before_launching.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

A few thoughtful updates before launch can help your ad make a stronger first impression. Check that your venue page is clear, current and ready for the customers your campaign may bring.

**Show your dishes at their best:** Clear, appetizing photos can help customers choose with confidence. Focus first on your bestselling items, and use the [menu photo guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/add-edit-menu-photos) for practical image guidance.

**Make your menu easy to explore:** Use clear categories, accurate descriptions and up-to-date item availability so a new customer can quickly understand what you offer. The [menu management guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/manage-menu) explains how to make changes in the Merchant Portal.

**Keep your details current:** Make sure your listed hours and item availability reflect when you are ready to receive orders. If the kitchen becomes especially busy, you remain free to go temporarily offline and return when you are ready. The [venue availability guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/improve-venue-availability) shows you how.

**Choose whether to add a promotion:** Ads increase visibility, while a Promo can give customers an extra reason to order. Combining the two can support both discovery and purchase, but it is optional. The [marketing offers guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/choose-best-wolt-marketing-offers) can help you choose what best fits your goal and budget.

## **How do you actually set up the campaign?**

Once your venue page is ready, the campaign setup is straightforward and keeps the budget and schedule in your hands.

**Open the Merchant Portal:** Use the [Merchant Portal login guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/log-in-wolt-merchant-portal) if you need help signing in. Then select Campaigns in the left navigation and choose New campaign.

**Choose Ads:** Select Ads, then Get started. Sponsored Listings help place your venue in prominent positions across the app. The [Wolt Ads for merchants page](https://merchant.wolt.com/wolt-ads/wolt-ads-for-merchants) provides a current product overview.

**Set your budget and schedule:** Choose a campaign budget and dates that feel right for your business. Review the campaign details in the Merchant Portal before moving on.

**Review your campaign details:** Check the budget and schedule, read and agree to the terms and conditions, then select Create campaign. You can follow its performance from the Campaigns section.

**Choose a useful test period:** There is no universal ideal duration. Pick a defined period that fits your budget and should generate enough completed orders to give you something meaningful to review.

## **How much should you spend on your first campaign?**

![A man types on a laptop with Wolt stickers, beside a woman working, surrounded by Wolt-branded office items.](https://images.ctfassets.net/23u853certza/6Bggm8ykHZJuOh5sl7y9va/f7f1c5ba87c195c740fb36c0a71ef5b3/How_much_should_you_spend_on_your_first_campaign.png?w=3840&q=75&fm=webp)

The best first budget is one that supports your goal without putting pressure on your margins. Your average order value, food costs and normal order volume can all help you choose a comfortable starting point.

**Work backwards from your budget:** Decide what you can comfortably invest, then compare campaign sales and orders with that spend. Because Wolt Ads are pay per order, you pay only for completed orders attributed to the ad.

**Start with a budget you can learn from:** Treat your first campaign as a test. Review the results before increasing spend or changing the schedule. The [marketing campaigns guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/marketing-campaigns-use-ads-promos) walks through setup and performance monitoring.

## **How do you know if your first campaign worked?**

Reviewing your results turns a first campaign into a useful learning exercise. The data can help you decide whether to continue, adjust your budget or schedule, or try a different combination of marketing tools.

**Review the campaign report:** In the Merchant Portal, open Campaigns and look at total sales, total spend, orders from Ads, return on ad spend, average cost per order and average order value. The [campaign results guide](https://merchant.wolt.com/learning-center/interpret-marketing-campaign-results) explains each metric.
